svg.title: One agreement, distinct record roles
svg.desc: Choose who owns each fact before configuring automation. Legal document: Executed terms: Retain the accepted version and signing evidence.. Commercial Contract: Service commitment: Keep the agreed scope, value and effective term.. Deal: Sales or renewal opportunity: Track the opportunity and its outcome.. Billing record: Charges and payments: Retain the schedule, invoices and payment evidence.. Use a stable agreement key to connect the records. Multiple agreements for one customer keep separate identities. CRM visibility does not itself move billing ownership.
